incident-bot: 🚨 High error rate detected: 504/502 spike from edge proxies to inference-gateway. alert_id=INF-GW-504-1779000123
Luca (on-call): I’m paged, grabbing context. What’s the blast radius?
Maya (support): Seeing a handful of customers report timeouts for long-completion jobs (~>10s). Support queue lighting up, some prod customers impacted.
Priya (SRE): From traces: a surge of backend latency from the model-hosting pool starting ~+30s before alert. Gateway attempts to retry, hits upstream timeouts -> 504s.
Sam (runtime): Rolling 2 recent kernel changes? We deployed a small runtime tweak for socket keepalive last night to reduce cold-starts. Possible interaction with our LB idle timeout. Pulling logs.
Luca (on-call): Priya, can you confirm which region and which pool?
Priya (SRE): NYC region, model-pool-dedicated-5. Top upstream IPs: 10.2.33.*. Metrics: p50 latency normal, p95 jumps from 150ms -> 2.1s, connection establish errors +200%
Sam (runtime): Dumping nginx/gateway logs -> saw repeated `upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header` for same request IDs. Suspect keepalive connections dropped and we’re re-creating sockets causing head-of-line.
Jorge (eng): Any recent traffic shape changes? Canary or load test?
Nina (PM): No planned load tests. A batch job from a partner kicked off around the same time (high token counts). Could be correlated.
Priya (SRE): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) increase gateway upstream timeout from 10s -> 25s temporarily, 2) disable the new runtime keepalive flag as a rollback, 3) scale model-pool-dedicated-5 by +2 instances to absorb backlog.
Luca (on-call): +1 to that. Do we expect any risks to increasing timeout? Might just mask real failures.
Sam (runtime): Rolling a hotfix to toggle keepalive off for the pool now. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/runtime-pool-dedicated-5 KEEPALIVE_ENABLED=false --namespace=prod`
Priya (SRE): Applying gateway change now: updating `nginx.conf` upstream `proxy_read_timeout` to `25s` for inference-gateway. Will reload config.
Priya (SRE): Scaling pool: `scale set model-pool-dedicated-5 --replicas 8` (was 6). Watching.
Luca (on-call): Anyone owning the rollback of change that rolled out last night? Sam?
Sam (runtime): I pushed the rollback flag. Confirmed pods restarted with KEEPALIVE_ENABLED=false. Observability: connection errors dropping.
Priya (SRE): After scale and rollback: error rate dropped ~80% in the last 90s. p95 latency coming down to ~350ms. No new customer pages so far.
Maya (support): Not seeing fresh customer complaints in queue, but will triage the ones that arrived and notify customers about temporary impact and mitigation. Drafting a message for affected customers.
Jorge (eng): Any config changes we need to revert later? We should record this as short-term mitigation, not permanent.
Luca (on-call): Agreed. Plan: keep gateway timeout at 25s for 1 hour while we monitor, then revert to 10s if stable. Leave keepalive disabled until we validate a safe config.
Nina (PM): Which customers were impacted? Any high-SLA ones?
Maya (support): Two mid-market customers had retries and elevated error rates; none of the enterprise SLA customers reported major outage but they saw higher latencies briefly. I’ll send the list to CS.
Priya (SRE): Root cause hypothesis: keepalive change + a single large token job causing backend queueing -> many concurrent connections and retries exhausting connection pool/causing upstream establish failures. Need follow-ups: adjust max connections, tune client-side retries, and add an alert for upstream connection errors spike.
Sam (runtime): I’ll put a revert PR with a safe reintroduced config and tests for keepalive behavior under high fanout. Also adding limit on concurrent long-run requests per model variant.
Luca (on-call): Handoff in 30m to Priya? I’ll stay until we confirm stability.
Priya (SRE): I can take on-call after handoff. Action items to capture now: 1) Hotfix applied (rollback of KEEPALIVE) — Sam (done). 2) Temp gateway timeout bump to 25s — Priya (done). 3) Scale pool +2 — Priya (done). 4) Support notifications — Maya (in progress). 5) Postmortem + runbook updates — Jorge & Nina. 6) Alerts tuning: add alert on `upstream_connection_errors > 50/min` and `p95_lat>1s for 5m` — Priya/Sam. 7) Add guardrail for long-run partner jobs (rate limit or scheduling) — Sam/Nina.
Maya (support): Customer message ready for review: "We experienced intermittent timeouts for long-completion requests between 15:03–15:12 UTC. We mitigated by rolling back a recent runtime setting and scaling capacity; normal service resumed at ~15:15 UTC. We’ll follow up with a postmortem."
Luca (on-call): Approve. Send with note that CS will provide one-off credits if customers request.
Priya (SRE): Quick runbook additions I propose now (we can formalize in doc): - checklist to run when `INF-GW-504`: identify pool, toggle KEEPALIVE, bump gateway timeout, scale pool, monitor downstream queue length. Add exact commands and headings.
Jorge (eng): I’ll create a PR to the runbook repo with those steps and include rollback criteria + metrics thresholds. Assigning to me and Nina for review.
Sam (runtime): Alerts: I’m adding dashboards for connection errors and a synthetic long-completion test that runs every 10m to spot regressions.
Nina (PM): Postmortem owners: Jorge (write up), Sam (technical RCA), Priya (ops timeline), Maya (customer impact & comms). Target: initial draft in 48h, slack post with summary in 72h.
Luca (on-call): Thanks team. I’m handing off in 28m to Priya. I’ll drop a final status update right before the handoff.
Priya (SRE): Acknowledged. Current status: stable, error rate ~normal, monitoring tight. Will follow up with runbook PR + alert PR after handoff.
Maya (support): Sent customer notifications. Will monitor replies and collect any logs customers provide.
incident-bot: Incident INF-GW-504-1779000123 set to MONITORING by Luca. Tags: mitigation-applied, rollback-runtime-flag, scaled-pool
Luca (on-call): Final note before handoff: keep an eye on partner batch jobs; if another large job fires, consider pausing partner ingestion temporarily. Handoff to Priya in 25m.
Priya (SRE): Taking over on-call at 1779002430. I’ll keep the temp timeout in place until 1779006030 unless we decide earlier.
Jorge (eng): Creating runbook PR now: https://git.internal/runbooks/inf-gw-504-pr
Nina (PM): Adding postmortem checklist to the ticket.
Sam (runtime): Added feature flag test coverage to prevent this regression from reaching prod again.
Maya (support): Closing customer threads that acknowledged the notice; keeping others open.
Luca (on-call): Closing my side. Good work team.
